property_summary: For any call to multiplicate with a positive msg.value, the reference C's transfer of balance+msg.value (which exceeds the contract's holdings) must revert, so every admissible positive-value call fails; the mutant's strict '>' guard skips the transfer entirely and therefore succeeds, which the assertion (call must not succeed) detects.
change_summary: Change the guard condition from '>=' to '>' so the transfer is skipped when msg.value equals the contract balance.
